code_commit_at_rollout: 31cb1f4 (training code); audit script src/minipi_getup/ftsr_ref/velocity_audit.py (evaluation only, committed with these results)
task: Mjlab-FTSR-Ref-MiniPi-Recovery-Stateless, play cfg (no observation noise), ZERO assistance
reset_noise: euler 0.3 rad, joints 0.3 rad (training reset event), seeded
episode: 20 s = 2 s passive (kp 0, kd 1) + 18 s policy; 999 policy steps recorded

simulation.plant: MuJoCo position actuator, tau = clip(kp (q*-q) - kd qd, +-16 Nm); no torque-speed envelope; no target slew

reward_attribution: reward table stage fixed to r_w (stage 2) during the audit = the training population's stage (S1/S2 ~0.87); no effect on dynamics (no assistance in play)
recording: physics-step (0.5 ms): q, qd, actuator force, unclipped PD torque (pre-step state), joint-space constraint force, base height, uprightness, ground-contact groups; policy-step: q*, unclipped command, action, qpos, every reward term, validity flags

definitions.recovered: mean base height over the last 3 s > h1 = 0.19 m and mean upright cos > cos 18 deg (as analyze_recovery / periodic eval)
definitions.strict: base > 0.31 m and upright within 18 deg at every step of the last 3 s
definitions.invalid: action-term non-finite flag, nan termination or non-finite qd in the episode (none observed)
definitions.phases: A: policy start -> first base > h1; B: -> first base > h2 (0.276 m); C: -> first 0.5 s continuously > h2 and upright; D: after (first crossings; regressions reported separately)
definitions.spike_event: contiguous physics steps with |qd| > 20 rad/s on one joint
definitions.large_target_jump: >= 0.25 rad change of q* in one 20 ms policy step (alone commands >= 12.5 rad/s)
definitions.limit_violation: physical joint position beyond the XML range by > 5 mrad (not commanded-target clipping)

best_autonomous_checkpoint: model_3000 (periodic eval best_recovery.json: 99.6 % over 64 envs/pose; 100 % here)
counterfactuals: counterfactual_it3000_rate0p{1,2,3}: model_3000 with an evaluation-only PD-target rate limit of 0.1/0.2/0.3 rad per policy step (not the training plant)
commands: python -m minipi_getup.ftsr_ref.velocity_audit analyze --runs <runs...> --primary runs/it_3000 runs/it_3500 --out results/ftsr_velocity_audit
python -m minipi_getup.ftsr_ref.velocity_audit videos --run runs/it_3000 --out results/ftsr_velocity_audit (and it_3500)
raw_data: runs/*/rollout.npz (~0.9 GB each, git-ignored, kept locally)
training_interaction: training (ftsr_recovery_pd16_noslew_resume2700) was never stopped; audit rollouts ran concurrently (one at a time), iteration time rose from ~3.3 s to up to ~6.5 s during overlapping windows
